inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation: The operation did not have documentation that the carbon monoxide detectors were tested for the previous month.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Document Test Date, Battery Installation Date, and Staff Name Testing and Installation (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: During the inspection, one classroom did not have the cots labeled with the child's name.    Note: This was corrected at inspection when cots were  labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Self-Reported: During investigation it was found, two children were able to open the door and go onto another classroom and were unsupervised for approximately 8 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: During inspection, one vehicle's transportation van lacked the required thermometer and scissors in the first aid kit.     Note: This was corrected during inspection when director added the thermometer and scissors to first aid kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: During inspection, one of the fire extinguishers was last serviced 03/2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found during an investigation that a child was left unsupervised for less than 5 minutes in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three out of the five written feeding instructions reviewed were not signed by parent or updated signature by last 30 days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Medical Authorization: Two out of ten files reviewed did not have the authorization for emergency medical attention completed and signed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During investigation it was found, a child was able to open the door and go onto the playground unsupervised for less than 1 minute.      *The operation did notify CCR of the incident*
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It was found during an investigation that two children were unsupervised on the playground for less than 2 minutes.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- signed dated statement that employee attended abuse/neglect training: 3 of the 10 files audited are missing signed statements employees attend orientation to the operation.  This was corrected when the orientation statement was added to the 3 files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Current Driver's License (26 TAC §746.901(10))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: It is determined through an investigation that children were unsupervised outside on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: 1 child's file does not contain an emergency contact address.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap: Two pieces of play equipment on the playground have use zones that are overlapping.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - No Overlap (26 TAC §746.4805(d))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 2 files reviewed do not contain up to date immunization requirements.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information-Completed Food Allergy Plan (26 TAC §746.605(16))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: During the investigation, it was determined that the operation failed to notify CCR of an incident that placed a child at risk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk: There was no incident report created within the adequate timeframe and the parent was not given a written notification on the details of the incident.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.701(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Sufficient evidence confirmed that a two-year-old caregiver grabbed and pulled a child's forearm leaving a bruise.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on interviews conducted it was determined that the caregiver in the two-year-old classroom raised her voice to a child in a harsh manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space: School age children were found laying down right next to each with no space between them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -Provides Sufficient Walking and Work Space (26 TAC §746.2909(3))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One children's files reviewed did not have a current immunization record.   Note: The immunization record was obtained during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: Three classrooms were found with electrical cords hanging at children's reach.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using: Water table was noted with standing water.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Empty Water Play Tables, Sanitize Water Play Toys, Wash Hands Before Using (26 TAC §746.3407(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Four out of eight feeding forms were found not updated. Forms were signed and dated as of April 2023.   One child's feeding form was not ready for review.

occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)
